name: medimate
description: MEDIMATE — Track • Remind • Live Healthier. Pharmacy discovery, medication reminders and wellness tracking over web, SMS and USSD.

scripts.setup: npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.test: npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
